_doc: EXAMPLE. /jobprep-setup writes yours to profile/search.json (gitignored). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_archetypes: Title phrases per archetype, matched as whole words, any case. End a phrase with * to match a prefix.
_exclude_titles: A title containing any of these is dropped, even when it matches an archetype.
_locations: Places you would work from. Leave empty with remote false to search everywhere.
_remote: true keeps remote roles. false means being remote is not enough, the posting must still name one of your locations. remote_regions limits remote roles to regions you can work in. Empty means any remote role.
_pay: Top of the posted base range must reach base_pay_floor (USD, 0 turns the check off). unknown_pay is keep or drop for roles that post no base range.
_needs_sponsorship: true drops postings that say they will not sponsor a visa or that require citizenship or clearance.
_yc_roles: Optional. YC startup jobs by role family: software-engineer, designer, product-manager, recruiting-hr, sales-manager, marketing, support, operations, science.
